name: FASTEST 4:20 Feudal + 4 Yatai + 2 eco upg [by betelgeuse]
author: betelgeuse

notes: Queue [ 1 ] villager @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ in your TC @building_economy/town-center.webp@

Send [ 6 ] villagers @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ to kill sheep @resource/sheep.webp@(or direct to gold @resource/resource_gold.webp@, if it is very close to your TC @building_economy/town-center.webp@)
Move your scout @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@
Send [ 2 ] @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ villagers to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ chop a straggler tree (OR pick a tree next to your future Matsuri if wood is close to gold)
Send [ 1 ] @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ villager @abilities/repair.webp@ to build the @building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@Matsuri  near gold (and wood, if possible)
Shift-queue the builder to mine gold  after building.
Send [ 3 ] @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@villagers to mine gold @resource/resource_gold.webp@ near the Matsuri @building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@
Queue more villagers
@resource/rally.webp@ Rally your @building_economy/town-center.webp@TC to @resource/sheep.webp@ sheep.
@resource/rally.webp@ Rally your @building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@Matsuri to the 1st SPOT FOR YATAI (usually @resource/boar.webp@boar or boar+smth else to get maximum income)
Matsuri placement tips:
Perfect: On gold and a woodline in a safe position for fast drop-offs
Good: Between gold and a straggler tree near your TC
[ 3 ] @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@villagers will finish mining gold before the Matsuri is built. Use all [ 3 ] @abilities/repair.webp@ to help finish the building
--->> Drop [ 30 ] gold @resource/resource_gold.webp@
--->> Buy @resource/resource_wood.webp@wood in the @building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@ Matsuri and buy the 1st Yatai @unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@
--->> Keep [ 4 ] villagers on gold @resource/resource_gold.webp@

When you have [ 50 ] wood @resource/resource_wood.webp@ --->> move [ 1 ] villager from sheep @resource/sheep.webp@ to berries @resource/berrybush.webp@ and build @abilities/repair.webp@ a House @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@.
@unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@ 1st Yatai finishes: Make sure it goes to the correct spot
@resource/rally.webp@@building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@ Rally the Matsuri to the 2nd YATAI SPOT(usually @resource/deer.webp@deer or deer+smth)
@unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@@unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@@unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ Keep queuing villagers! Queue villagers #10 and #11 as soon as you have [ 50 ] food.
When you have [ 120 ] gold @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and your miners hold [ 10 ] gold --->> force-drop it --->> buy 2nd Yatai @unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@
Rally villager #12 @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@
2nd Yatai @unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@ finishes: Make sure it goes to the correct spot.
@resource/rally.webp@@building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@ Rally the Matsuri to the 3rd YATAI SPOT (usually on base between berry @resource/berrybush.webp@ and @resource/sheep.webp@ sheep)
When your @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@tree has [ 50 ] wood left (or you have [ 50 ] wood @resource/resource_wood.webp@ after getting 2nd yatai@unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@)
--->> move [ 1 ] woodchopper to sheep @resource/sheep.webp@ and [ 1 ] woodchopper to gold @resource/resource_gold.webp@.

At this point, you should have [ 40 ] gold @resource/resource_gold.webp@. Force-drop gold villagers @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@@resource/resource_gold.webp@ to get [ 50 ] and research the Tawara upgrade in the @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@ House @technology_japanese/towara-1.webp@.
When you have [ 6 ] on food @resource/resource_food.webp@ --->> @resource/rally.webp@rally the next villager to gold @resource/resource_gold.webp@.
Force-drop @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@@resource/resource_gold.webp@gold to get [ 130 ] --->> buy wood --->>buy the 3rd Yatai @unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@
[ 6 ] on gold @resource/resource_gold.webp@ --> @resource/rally.webp@ rally on food @resource/resource_food.webp@ until [ 8 ]
Create group of [ 7 ] villagers @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ ( 3 from gold @resource/resource_gold.webp@, 4 from food) for age up in advance
@resource/rally.webp@Rally new @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ villagers on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ wood (unfinished @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ tree first)
3rd @unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@ Yatai finishes: Make sure it goes to the correct spot
@resource/rally.webp@@building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@ Rally the Matsuri to the 4rd YATAI SPOT @unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@
Start building the Ryokan @landmark_sengoku/ryokan.webp@ with your prepared group of [ 7 ] villagers @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ ([ 4 ] from food, [ 3 ] from gold)

Send all remaining food villagers @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ to wood @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ (your Yatai will provide enough food to keep queuing new villagers non-stop meanwhile)

As soon as the Ryokan @landmark_sengoku/ryokan.webp@ is finished, you should have enough resources to research the 2nd economy upgrade @technology_japanese/takezaiku-2.webp@ in the House @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@and buy the 4th Yatai @unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@ right away

description:
Best conditions: This build works best on maps with safe starting gold (close to your TC) or if you are in a safe team position (pocket).
Why? 
- Your Matsuri is your main economy building and will be placed on gold. If it is in a bad spot, enemies will attack it early to cut off your gold and yatai which will ruin your economy.

Difficulty: Hard for beginners. It requires many fast actions in the first minutes (like force-dropping resources) while also controlling your scout etc
